title: Income Tax
description:
Given `income = 75000`, calculate the total tax using these brackets:
- 0% on the first $20,000
- 20% on income from $20,001 to $50,000
- 30% on income above $50,000

Print the total tax.

**Expected output:**
```
13500.0
```
starterCode:
income = 75000
tax = 0
# Calculate tax using the brackets
# Print total tax
hint: Break it into brackets: if income > 50000, add 30% of (income - 50000); if income > 20000, add 20% of (min(income, 50000) - 20000). The first 20000 is always tax-free.
